name: Grainy gouache
blurb: Riso grain, soft shading, cosy animals
mechanism: Outline-free shapes, each filled with a soft light-to-dark gradient and then speckled with a fine dark grain that thickens toward the shape's edges and into its shadows, sitting on hot pink #FF81BE with a chalky purple pool beneath.

line: No outlines; fills only. Detail lines 0.6-1.3 px round-capped in dark brown (veins 0.6-0.7, whiskers 0.75-0.8, mouth 1.05); cream decor lines 1.1-1.35; screen code 2.2-2.6.
rules: Hot pink #FF81BE background on every card, even at night
No outlines: shapes separate by value steps and grain
Every big shape gets a gradient plus edge-gathered grain
Big glossy eyes: cream ring, offset pupil, star highlight
Chalky purple-pink pool under the group; nothing floats
7-8 grained leaves and cream sparkles, margins only
